statistics.behaviors: ratio of summed chosen/opportunities (gold amount/opportunities); same WORLD draws per arm
statistics.labels: label-weighted clustered_mean; complete TEST rows, never rowwise resampling
statistics.parameter_relative_delta: L2 norm of actor parameter displacement since initialization / initial actor parameter L2 norm

notes: All selected checkpoints frozen before TEST. TEST does not tune any setting.
FIT diagnostic uses fixed 128-row subset, not all training rows; VALIDATION is separate.
Probe cadence: 100 supervised optimizer steps per block, not PPO updates; per-act source-world coverage is exported.
Full-game source is greedy evaluation; no stochastic training game win-rate claim.

Observed shares of menus with >=2 legal actions and the matching WorldMetrics opportunity; other options may be unavailable. Policy-dependent cohorts are descriptive, not causal; these are not pure free-choice propensities.
Only G2 wins have a predeclared 1 percentage-point NI margin. No margin for floor, HP, boss rates or G1.
Intervals are supplied directly or computed in frozen runtime, never subtracted from arm CIs.
Constant observed differences can yield degenerate bootstrap CIs; undefined conditional draws are counted/omitted.
